test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

"The plants were watered by the gardener every morning."

options.text: The gardener has watered the plants every morning.
The gardener waters the plants every morning.
The gardener watered the plants every morning.
The gardener is watering the plants every morning.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The plants were watered by the gardener every morning."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the gardener" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "were watered" to "watered" (simple past active).
 
• Retain the time phrase "every morning" at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The gardener watered the plants every morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The gardener has watered the plants every morning." – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The gardener waters the plants every morning." – Incorrect tense (present simple).
 
• **Option 4: **"The gardener is watering the plants every morning." – Incorrect tense (present continuous).
